## Loading Packages and Datafiles

```{r warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotrix)
library(car)
library(MASS)
library(lmerTest)
library(nlme)
library(lme4)
library(vegan)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)
library(MuMIn)
library(DHARMa)



# IMPORT DATA FILE OR SET WORKING DIRECTORY

# IMPORT DATA FILED CALLED : Master_OHP_Data_NERC_Submission_May4_2026

data<-Master_OHP_Data_NERC_Submission_May4_2026
str(data)
colnames(data)

##### I removed C14:0 and C16:0 peaks when calculating F:B ratios

data$f.plot<-factor(data$plot)
data$f.nb_pair<-factor(data$nb_pair)
data$f.Harvest<-factor(data$Harvest)
data$f.Litter_Type<-factor(data$Litter_Type)
data$f.Treatment<-factor(data$Treatment)
data$years<-rep(c(10,13,21,34), each=60)

```


## Splitting data into respectives harvests (H3 and H4)

```{r}
H3.data<-subset(data, Harvest == 3)
H4.data<-subset(data, Harvest == 4)

c.data<-data %>% filter(Harvest == 3 | Harvest == 4)

ftir.data<-c.data %>% dplyr::select(c(11:25,54,56,57,58)) %>% 
  group_by(f.plot, f.Harvest,f.Treatment,f.Litter_Type) %>%
  summarise(across(1:15, mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


plfa.data<-H3.data %>% dplyr::select(c(26:43,54,57,58)) %>% 
  group_by(f.plot,f.Treatment,f.Litter_Type) %>%
  summarise(across(1:18, mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")



```

## C:N of Leaf Litter
#### H3

```{r}

C.N_percent_summary_H3 <- H3.data %>% 
  group_by( f.Treatment,f.Litter_Type) %>%   
  summarise(N.mean = mean(N_percent,na.rm=TRUE),  
            N.se = std.error(N_percent),
            C.mean = mean(C_percent,na.rm=TRUE),
            C.se = std.error(C_percent),
            C.N.mean = mean(C.N.ratio,na.rm=TRUE),  
            C.N.se = std.error(C.N.ratio))
C.N_percent_summary_H3<-data.frame(C.N_percent_summary_H3)

nitrogen.percent.H3 <- lmer(N_percent~ f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type + (1|f.plot),  data = H3.data)
summary(nitrogen.percent.H3) 
anova(nitrogen.percent.H3)

round(r.squaredGLMM(nitrogen.percent.H3),4)

plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = nitrogen.percent.H3))

dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)

N_percent.H3.fig<-ggplot(C.N_percent_summary_H3 , aes(f.Treatment, N.mean,fill=f.Litter_Type)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = N.mean - N.se, ymax = N.mean  + N.se),position=dodge,width=0.3,size=0.6) + 
  geom_point(data=H3.data, aes(x=f.Treatment,y=N_percent,group=f.Litter_Type), shape=21,position=dodge,size=2,color="black",stroke=0.4,alpha=0.4) +
  geom_point(stat="identity",position=dodge,size=6,shape=21,color="black",alpha=1) +
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("slategray3","palevioletred1"),labels = c("Control", "Experimental"))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Ambient", "Drought"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.8,2), breaks =c(1,1.2,1.4,1.6,1.8))+
  guides(fill="none")+
  labs(x = "Environment", y="Percent", title = "% Nitrogen",fill="Litter Origin") +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size = 17),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size=21))
N_percent.H3.fig


carbon.percent.H3 <- lmer(C_percent~ f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type + (1|f.plot),  data = H3.data)
summary(carbon.percent.H3) 
anova(carbon.percent.H3)

round(r.squaredGLMM(carbon.percent.H3),4)

plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = carbon.percent.H3))

C_percent.H3.fig<-ggplot(C.N_percent_summary_H3 , aes(f.Treatment, C.mean,fill=f.Litter_Type)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = C.mean - C.se, ymax = C.mean  + C.se),position=dodge,width=0.3,size=0.6) + 
  geom_point(data=H3.data, aes(x=f.Treatment,y=C_percent,group=f.Litter_Type), shape=21,position=dodge,size=2,color="black",stroke=0.4,alpha=0.4) +
  geom_point(stat="identity",position=dodge,size=6,shape=21,color="black",alpha=1) +
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("slategray3","palevioletred1"),labels = c("Control", "Experimental"))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Ambient", "Drought"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(42,51), breaks =c(44,46,48,50))+
  guides(fill="none")+
  labs(x = "Environment", y="Percent", title = "% Carbon",fill="Litter Origin") +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size = 17),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size=21))
C_percent.H3.fig


C.N.H3 <- lmer(C.N.ratio~ f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type + (1|f.plot),  data = H3.data)
summary(C.N.H3) 
anova(C.N.H3)

round(r.squaredGLMM(C.N.H3),4)


plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = C.N.H3 ))

C.N.H3.fig<-ggplot(C.N_percent_summary_H3 , aes(f.Treatment, C.N.mean,fill=f.Litter_Type)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = C.N.mean - C.N.se, ymax = C.N.mean  + C.N.se),position=dodge,width=0.3,size=0.6) + 
  geom_point(data=H3.data, aes(x=f.Treatment,y=C.N.ratio,group=f.Litter_Type), shape=21,position=dodge,size=2,color="black",stroke=0.4,alpha=0.4) +
  geom_point(stat="identity",position=dodge,size=6,shape=21,color="black",alpha=1) +
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("slategray3","palevioletred1"),labels = c("Control", "Experimental"))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Ambient", "Drought"))+
   scale_y_continuous(limits = c(23,55), breaks =c(25,30,35,40,45,50))+
  #guides(fill="none")+
  labs(x = "Environment", y="Ratio", title = "Carbon : Nitrogen",fill="Litter Origin") +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size = 17),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        legend.position="bottom",
        plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size=21))
C.N.H3.fig

#jpeg("OHP_H3_C_N.jpeg", width=900, height=2000, res = 150, quality = 200)
#plot_grid(C_percent.H3.fig,N_percent.H3.fig,C.N.H3.fig, labels = c("A", "B", "C"), label_size = 15,ncol = 1)
#dev.off()



```

C.N_percent_summary_H4 <- H4.data %>%

## FTIR H3

```{r}

## AVERAGED DATA AT THE SUBPLOT LEVEL

ftir.h3.data<-filter(ftir.data, f.Harvest==3)

set.seed(123) # INTERACTION WAS NOT SIGNIFICANT SO RE-RAN THE MODEL
#adonis2(scale(ftir.h3.data[,c(5:19)])~f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type  ,method="euclidean",data=ftir.h3.data,by="terms")
adonis2(scale(ftir.h3.data[,c(5:19)])~f.Treatment+f.Litter_Type  ,method="euclidean",data=ftir.h3.data,by="terms")


FTIR.H3.PCA.pl <- rda(ftir.h3.data[,c(5:19)],scale=TRUE) 

summary(FTIR.H3.PCA.pl)

scores.pca.FTIR.H3.pl<-vegan::scores(FTIR.H3.PCA.pl, choices=c(1,2), scaling=3) 

Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl <- data.frame(scores.pca.FTIR.H3.pl$species)
  
Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl$Band <- rownames(Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl)
  
Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl <- data.frame(scores.pca.FTIR.H3.pl$sites) 
  
Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl<-data.frame(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl,ftir.h3.data$f.Litter_Type,ftir.h3.data$f.Treatment)
colnames(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl)
colnames(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl)[3]<-"f.Litter_Type"
colnames(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl)[4]<-"f.Treatment"

OHP_FTIR_H3_pl.fig<-ggplot(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl, aes(x = PC1, y =PC2)) + 
  geom_segment(data = Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl, aes(xend = PC1, yend = PC2,x = 0, y = 0),col = "black",size=1, 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"))) +
  geom_label_repel(data = Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = rownames(Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA.pl)), col = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(fill=f.Litter_Type,shape=f.Treatment),size=5,alpha = 0.9) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = c("slategray3","palevioletred1"),labels = c("Control", "Experimental"))+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(22,24),labels = c("Ambient", "Drought"))+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, stroke=0),order=1 ),
         shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "black", stroke=0)) )+
  labs(title="Leaf Litter Functional Groups",
       x="PC1 (43.96% Variance Explained)",
       y="PC2 (23.01% Variance Explained)", shape="Environment", fill = "Litter Origin")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size = 17),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
         legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size=21))



#####################################################################################


## DATA AT THE LITTERBAG LEVEL

set.seed(123)

adonis2(scale(H3.data[,c(11:25)])~f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type  ,method="euclidean",data=H3.data,by="terms")

FTIR.H3.PCA <- rda(H3.data[,c(11:25)],scale=TRUE) 
  
summary(FTIR.H3.PCA)

scores.pca.FTIR.H3<-vegan::scores(FTIR.H3.PCA, choices=c(1,2), scaling=3) 

Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA <- data.frame(scores.pca.FTIR.H3$species)
  
Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA$Band <- rownames(Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA)
  
Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA <- data.frame(scores.pca.FTIR.H3$sites) 
  
Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA<-data.frame(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA,H3.data$f.Litter_Type,H3.data$f.Treatment)
colnames(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA)
colnames(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA)[3]<-"f.Litter_Type"
colnames(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA)[4]<-"f.Treatment"


OHP_FTIR_H3_lb.fig<-ggplot(Sample.FTIR.H3.PCA, aes(x = PC1, y =PC2)) + 
  geom_segment(data = Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA, aes(xend = PC1, yend = PC2,x = 0, y = 0),col = "black",size=1, 
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"))) +
  geom_label_repel(data = Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = rownames(Bands.FTIR.H3.PCA)), col = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(fill=f.Litter_Type,shape=f.Treatment),size=5,alpha = 0.9) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = c("slategray3","palevioletred1"),labels = c("Control", "Experimental"))+
    scale_shape_manual(values=c(22,24),labels = c("Ambient", "Drought"))+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, stroke=0),order=1 ),
         shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "black", stroke=0)) )+
  labs(title="Leaf Litter Functional Groups",
       x="PC1 (35.29% Variance Explained)",
       y="PC2 (29.29% Variance Explained)", shape="Environment", fill = "Litter Origin")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size = 17),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "grey2", size =15),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "grey2", size =17),
         legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size=21))

fauna_abun_H3_summary <- H3.data %>% 
  group_by( f.Treatment,f.Litter_Type) %>%   
  summarise(c.mean = mean(Collembolan_Abundance_DW),  
            c.se = std.error(Collembolan_Abundance_DW),
            o.mean = mean(Oribatida_Abundance_DW),

            m.mean = mean(Mesostigmata_Abundance_DW),  
            m.se = std.error(Mesostigmata_Abundance_DW),
            a.mean = mean(Astigmata_Abundance_DW),  
            a.se = std.error(Astigmata_Abundance_DW),
            p.mean = mean(Prostigmata_Abundance_DW),  
            p.se = std.error(Prostigmata_Abundance_DW),
            ot.mean = mean(Other_Fauna_Abundance_DW),  
            ot.se = std.error(Other_Fauna_Abundance_DW),
            t.mean = mean(Total_Abundance_DW),  
            t.se = std.error(Total_Abundance_DW))
fauna_abun_H3_summary<-data.frame(fauna_abun_H3_summary)


coll.abun.H3 <- lmer(Collembolan_Abundance_DW ~  f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type + (1|f.plot) , data = H3.data)
summary(coll.abun.H3)
anova(coll.abun.H3)


round(r.squaredGLMM(coll.abun.H3),4)

plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = coll.abun.H3))



orib.abun.H3<- lmer(Oribatida_Abundance_DW ~  f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type + (1|f.plot) , data = H3.data)

anova(orib.abun.H3)

round(r.squaredGLMM(orib.abun.H3),4)

plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = orib.abun.H3))

summary(other.abun.H4)
anova(other.abun.H4)

round(r.squaredGLMM(other.abun.H4),4)

plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = other.abun.H4)) 



total.abun.H4  <- lmer(Total_Abundance_DW ~ f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type + (1|f.plot), data = H4.data)
summary(total.abun.H4) 
anova(total.abun.H4)

round(r.squaredGLMM(total.abun.H4),4)

plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = total.abun.H4)) 



```

## Litter moisture
#### H3

```{r}
Moisture_H3_summary <- H3.data %>% 
  group_by( f.Treatment,f.Litter_Type) %>%   
  summarise(mois.mean = mean(Moisture_perc),  
            mois.se = std.error(Moisture_perc))
Moisture_H3_summary <-data.frame(Moisture_H3_summary)

Moisture.H3.mod <- lmer(Moisture_perc~ f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type + (1|f.plot),  data = H3.data)
summary(Moisture.H3.mod) 
anova(Moisture.H3.mod)

round(r.squaredGLMM(Moisture.H3.mod),4)

plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = Moisture.H3.mod)) 




```

#### H4

```{r}
Moisture_H4_summary <- H4.data %>% 
  group_by( f.Treatment,f.Litter_Type) %>%   
  summarise(mois.mean = mean(Moisture_perc),  
            mois.se = std.error(Moisture_perc))
Moisture_H4_summary <-data.frame(Moisture_H4_summary)

Moisture.H4.mod <- lmer(Moisture_perc~ f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type + (1|f.plot),  data = H4.data)
summary(Moisture.H4.mod) # remove f.plot

Moisture.H4.modb<- lm(Moisture_perc ~ f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type,contrasts=list('f.Treatment'=contr.sum, 'f.Litter_Type'=contr.sum)  , data = H4.data)
summary(Moisture.H4.modb)
Anova(Moisture.H4.modb,type="3")

plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = Moisture.H4.modb)) 
# there are some extreme values, when transformed, it does not make a difference for significance

Moisture.H4.modc<- lm(asin(sqrt(Moisture_perc*0.01)) ~ f.Treatment*f.Litter_Type,contrasts=list('f.Treatment'=contr.sum, 'f.Litter_Type'=contr.sum)  , data = H4.data)
summary(Moisture.H4.modc)
Anova(Moisture.H4.modc,type="3")

plot(simulateResiduals(fittedModel = Moisture.H4.modc)) 


# after transformation, helps distribution a bit but does not affect results, just have a few extreme outliers
# that affect the distribution of data


```
